Find the particular solution yp(x) of the equation x2d2ydx2−3xdydx+4y=4ln⁡x,x>0.

Hint: Consider using the substitution x=et.

a
 yp(x)=2ln⁡x
b
 yp(x)=xln⁡x+2
c
 yp(x)=2ln⁡x−3
d
 yp(x)=x2ln⁡x
e
 yp(x)=ln⁡x+1
